method: IoStore container listing of every non-MJOLNIR .utoc; export classes and imported packages from zen package headers; mesh vertex counts and bounds from `mjolnir mesh list`; level usage = transitive imports from each shipped level's umaps (Tags excluded); PWR use = PWR containers' imported packages + every /Game path in levels/warfare/pwr and pwr.level.json

fields.kind: export class of the asset, normalised
fields.verts: render vertices from mjolnir mesh list (not triangles)
fields.bounds_m: local bounds in metres (x, y, z)
fields.pwr_uses: yes = in the built map (PWR containers import it or pwr.level.json / upgrade json names it); listed = named only in a PWR palette or script; no
fields.pwr_family_used: a sibling in the same folder is used by PWR
fields.where: where on PWR it would go
